test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: S gets 65, 74, 62, 68 and 68 marks in Hindi, English, Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, respectively. His average marks in Mathematics, Hindi and English are _____________ more than the average marks in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.
solution:
**Given:**

Marks in Hindi = 65, English = 74, Mathematics = 62, Physics = 68, Chemistry = 68

**Calculation:**

Average marks in Mathematics, Hindi, and English = (62 + 65 + 74) / 3 = 67

Average marks in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry = (62 + 68 + 68) / 3 = 66

**∴ The average marks in Mathematics, Hindi, and English are 1 mark more than the average marks in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.**
